:::{#thm-interval-uncountable}
#### The unit interval is not countable

The interval $[0, 1]$ is not [countable](#def-countable-set).

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

The standard proof is Cantor's diagonal argument:
given any sequence of numbers in $[0, 1]$,
it builds a number in $[0, 1]$ whose decimal expansion differs from the $n$th number's in the $n$th digit,
so the sequence misses it
(see [Wikipedia: Cantor's diagonal argument](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cantor%27s_diagonal_argument)).

:::
